title: saussurea alpina var. ledebourii
intro: Saussurea alpina var. ledebourii, commonly known as Ledebour's saussurea, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used in medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Saussurea alpina var. ledebourii include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alpinumine and ledebourilactone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
